name: Jack the Ripper
bible: A tall, slim, gaunt gentleman of about fifty: narrow-shouldered, very upright, long-legged, with a composed and unhurried bearing. Face: pale, angular and smooth, half-shadowed under the brim of a tall black silk TOP HAT with a dark band; calm narrow grey eyes and a faint polite half-smile; the cheeks and jaw dissolve at their edges into drifting grey fog. Costume: a long charcoal-black INVERNESS coat to mid-calf with a short shoulder CAPE and dark horn buttons, a white shirt with a high collar and a black cravat, a dark grey waistcoat with a thin silver watch chain, dark trousers, polished black shoes and black leather gloves. Palette: charcoal, black, pale grey and silver. WEAPON: a pair of LONG SURGICAL KNIVES, one in EACH hand. Each is a long, thin, straight blade of bright polished surgical steel about as long as his forearm, with a slim ebony handle and a silver ferrule, held low in a forward grip like a surgeon. Energy and trails: thin, razor-sharp SILVER-WHITE slash lines with pale grey fog wisps and a few tiny crimson flecks.
design:
- top row: full-body stance facing right, a long surgical knife held low in each hand; a three-quarter head close-up under the top hat, with the fog at the jaw
- top row: a close view of the two long surgical knives and a small silver scalpel
- second row: a quick cross-cut with a silver slash line; a backhand slash; a walking pose with the coat cape swinging
- second row: a jump with the coat billowing
- third row: a lunging X-shaped double slash; a plunge with both knives driven down
- third row: a deep double thrust; a crouched guard with the knives crossed
- bottom row: a hit reaction; knocked down on the fog
- bottom row: a victory pose straightening the top hat with the knives behind his back; the Grim Fog vanishing into a grey fog cloud

sheetNotes.idle: Both knives are held low at his sides in a forward grip, the blades angled down and back, and he stands composed and upright. Fog drifts from the edges of his face and from his cuffs in every frame, and the coat sways gently with each breath. Standing guard (frame 5) crosses both knives in front of the chest. The crouch (frame 6) keeps the knives low on bent knees. The skid and the landing keep the knives low and the coat settling.
sheetNotes.run: Long, composed strides with an upright posture. The knives are carried low at his sides in a forward grip, blades angled down and back, and never raised. The long INVERNESS coat and the short cape swing and lift with each stride, with fog trailing from the coat hem.
sheetNotes.air: Airborne, the coat and the short cape billow upward in every frame, and the knives are held close to the body in a forward grip. The take-off crouch and the apex keep the knives gathered in. The falling and fast-fall frames stream the coat up with fog trailing behind. The wall slide and ledge frames keep the knives gripped in his hands, tucked close.
sheetNotes.dash: The dash frames show a roll tucked inside the long coat: the coat wraps around him in frames 2 and 3, and he comes out of the roll into a low crouch with the knives gripped forward. The ground dash and the air dash are low and fast, the knives forward and the fog streaking behind him. For the heal (frames 7 and 8) he pulls a small glass flask of glowing red potion from inside his coat and drinks it, head tipped back, the knives staying in his hands.
sheetNotes.hurt: The knives stay in his hands through every hurt frame. A light hit snaps his head back, and he recovers the balance with the knives brought back toward guard. A heavy hit bends him backward with the knives flung out. The launched and knockdown frames keep the knives gripped and the long coat flying. Knocked down, he lies on his back still holding both knives. Getting up and back on guard return the knives to the forward grip, low at the sides.
sheetNotes.atk-a: Quick surgical cuts. Combo strike 1: the right knife is drawn back across the body with the left knife low, then a fast horizontal cross-cut with the right knife, a thin silver-white slash line kept inside the cell. Combo strike 2: the left knife is raised high with the weight shifting, then a sharp diagonal backhand slash with the left knife, a thin silver arc kept inside the cell. Both recoveries bring the knives back low and the coat settles. The trails are thin and silver-white with pale grey wisps and a few crimson flecks.
sheetNotes.atk-b: The finisher draws both knives back wide with the front foot stepping in, then lunges into a double X-shaped slash: two crossing silver-white slash lines with pale fog kept inside the cell, the strongest pose. The recovery crosses the arms back with the coat cape flaring. In the air the knives are raised, then a spinning mid-air slash makes a ring of thin silver arcs kept inside the cell, and he lands in the airborne recovery with the coat billowing.
sheetNotes.atk-c: The plunge dives head first with both knives pointed straight down under the body and fog trailing; the impact lands in a low crouch with both knives driven into the ground and a burst of fog and dust kept inside the cell; the recovery rises with the knives pulled free. The heavy attack coils low with both knives drawn back at the hips and fog gathering, then drives a deep lunging double thrust with two long silver streaks kept inside the cell, and follows through as the fog dissipates. His body is SOLID and fully opaque in every frame of this sheet (the fog drifts around him, it never replaces him); no faded or ghostly frames.
sheetNotes.art: Grim Fog, his vanishing. Anticipation 1: he tips his top hat and fog coils round his shoes and coat. Anticipation 2: his body dissolves at the edges into dense grey fog, only the top hat and the knife blades still sharp. Execution 3: he vanishes into a thick grey-white fog cloud bursting outward, only a faint top-hatted silhouette and a silver glint showing inside. Execution 4: the cloud at full spread, a blurred shape and a ring of silver fog, all kept inside the cell. Recovery 5: the fog thins and he reforms, the top hat and knives visible. Recovery 6: upright again, straightening his coat as the fog clears.
sheetNotes.skill: Scalpel Rain, his own special: three silver scalpels arc out of the fog. Both knives stay in his hands; the left hand does the work. Anticipation 1: he raises the left hand into the fog, the left knife held back along the wrist. Anticipation 2: fog swirls up round the left hand and three small silver scalpels form above it. Execution 3: the hand sweeps down and forward, and three scalpels arc out of the fog. Execution 4: the three scalpels arc down through the fog at full force, a few crimson flecks flying. Recovery 5: the fog thins and the hand lowers. Recovery 6: back in the stance, the knives low at his sides.
sheetNotes.misc: Frames 1 to 3, skill throw: he reaches back with his free hand to take a small silver scalpel from inside his coat, flicks it forward underhand with the arm extended, and follows through. Frames 4 and 5, taunt: he tips his top hat to the opponent with a polite half-smile, then wipes a knife clean on a white handkerchief. Frames 6 to 8, victory: he straightens his top hat with the knives crossed behind his back, a calm, pleased look, fog curling round his shoes.
sheetNotes.ko: Defeat, frames 1 to 4: he staggers from the final blow, drops to one knee with a knife slipping from his grip, collapses forward and lies still in the fog. Intro, frames 5 to 8: he walks in carrying a black leather doctor's bag; he sets the bag down and draws the two long knives from inside his coat; he crosses them before his face in a precise flourish; he settles into his stance with fog at his feet.
